measure.title: Three numbers. All peer-reviewed.
measure.subtitle: Not a beauty score. Three independently interpretable biomarkers — each grounded in published imaging research.

card1.title: Inflammation Index
card1.desc: Cross-polarized light reveals erythema and barrier disruption — your skin's real-time immune response.
card1.tells: Tells you: Is a new product causing a reaction? Is your barrier healthy?

card2.title: Collagen Proxy
card2.desc: UV-A 405nm excitation reveals dermal collagen density via fluorescence — the structural architecture beneath your skin.
card2.tells: Tells you: Is your retinol or laser treatment actually working?

card3.title: Pigment Kinetics
card3.desc: Multi-spectral analysis tracks melanin distribution and velocity — especially powerful for melasma and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
card3.tells: Tells you: Is your melasma getting better or worse?
